It is not introduced by this slice; the move-only extraction needs its own registration before further binder work (successorNotes.Task14 binder size).

Task13: The client MUST NOT wait for a confirmation of a rebaseline ACK. When the stored `campaign_public_applied_view` row already covers the new baseline's cut (returning member, or rejoin after `campaign-application-confirmation-failed`), P2CA returns `stale` and the server sends nothing. Absence of a confirmation after a rebaseline means covered, never pending.

Confirmations are cumulative and at-least-once per committed receipt, not one per ACK. An ACK superseded in the single early-ACK slot by a later exact ACK of the same view receives neither a confirmation nor a refusal, and two racing ACKs of one receipt may produce one confirmation. A confirmation naming receipt R covers every earlier receipt of the same `viewId`.

`campaign-application-head-drift` leaves the view live and commits nothing; the client MUST re-send the same ACK (or ACK the next offer) to retry. `unknown-receipt`, `not-offered`, `receipt-required` and `current-authority` MUST NOT be retried with the same frame; rejoin for a fresh view.
ACKs MUST be sent in receipt order on one connection; the server's slot and commit ordering assume it.
Task13Optional: While a connection's view is live, every offer whose bytes the client has received is admissible: the offer in flight (until its write and the previous offer's commit settle) or the latest established offer. A `campaign-application-unknown-receipt` refusal therefore means the view changed (rejoin, supersession, or an altered or foreign receipt), never a server-side timing race; the client MUST treat it as a rejoin signal, not a retry signal.

hardCompositionPreconditions.concern: C1 convergence-gate blindness of receipt-mode participants (unchanged)
hardCompositionPreconditions.wording: Task 14 MUST NOT compose `applicationReceipts` into `bindCampaignSyncConnection` until the launch/readiness doors read `campaign_public_applied_view` rows for convergence; receipt-mode participants are not retained by `CampaignSyncSession` and the legacy numeric gate cannot see them.

hardCompositionPreconditions.concern: C2 / N3 same-connection seat read (updated: now guards two sites)
hardCompositionPreconditions.wording: `ICampaignApplicationReceiptPort.database()` MUST return the same better-sqlite3 connection `getSQLiteService().getDatabase()` returns, or the participant store must gain a handle-taking seat read that P2CE3's `preparePublicCut` and `readCurrentContext` both use. Two seat reads now run on the singleton inside transactions on the port's handle (the capture in `preparePublicCut` and P2CA's `accept`); the same-cut and same-context guarantees depend on them being one connection.
Every campaign served in receipt mode MUST have its effective-head branch backfilled before `applicationReceipts` is composed; otherwise joins fail closed with `campaign-application-unavailable`.

Typed refusals (`INVALID_INTENT campaign-application-*`) go through the legacy `send`, which swallows socket errors; a lost refusal is indistinguishable from a commit still in progress. Before composition either route refusals through `sendConfirmed` (closing on failure) or require the Task 13 client to bound its wait and rejoin.

`bindCampaignSyncConnection.ts` is 2197 physical / 1773 counted lines (max-lines 400 warning). Register the move-only extraction of `CampaignApplicationConnection`, `preparePublicCut`, `IApplicationView` and `ICampaignApplicationReceiptPort` into `src/lib/multiplayer/server/campaignApplicationConnection.ts` (P2CE2 `successorNotes.afterP2CE3`) and land it before Task 14 touches the binder again.

followUps.concern: CI flake: ThreeContextPrivacyEvidence random-collision (review round 2 section 7, N12)
followUps.wording: `ThreeContextPrivacyEvidence.test.ts`: journal revisions are asserted absent as bare decimal substrings (`71001`, `71003`, `72011`, `72012`) over a blob that contains random 32-hex ids (`opaqueRef`, `deliveryEpochId`). A random id containing one of those digit runs fails the suite (CI run 38874217230, PR #2155, about 2e-4 per run). Fix: assert revision absence structurally (walk the parsed history page, timeline and export and require no number or numeric string equal to a forbidden revision), or match JSON-delimited tokens (`:71003,`/`:71003}`/`"71003"`) instead of raw substrings; keep substring scans for the marker strings and `RAW_FIELD_NAMES`. Confirm with the forced-tail setup hook from the P2CE3 ci-flake attempt (`force-710036.setup.js`) that the fixed test passes with the colliding tail and still fails if a real `committedLastRevision` is injected.
followUps.note: Pre-existing and independent of P2CE3: the suite forbids bare revision substrings such as 71003 in output that contains a random 16-byte hex opaqueRef (and deliveryEpochId), so roughly 1-2 runs in 10,000 fail (author analytic 1.07e-4 and Monte Carlo 1.16e-4 for one random hex, 2.16e-4 for two; reviewer about 2e-4). It failed Unit Tests (1/6) on b803b5d1 (run 38874217230, opaqueRef 3bfa84e81e8a6d2cde4ea5788c710036); the final head b0077efa is 31/31 green. The fix needs its own registered scope that matches revisions as JSON-delimited tokens (or structurally); it is outside P2CE3 and is not registered or changed here.
